xref.title: Another Roadside Attraction Festival (1993)
xref.body: The Tragically Hip organized the festival "Another Roadside Attraction" in 1993, 1995, and 1997. This festival was one of several Canadian-based summer music events during the 90s, showcasing the growing strength and popularity of domestic music. "There was another roadside attraction, which was organized by the Trajically Hip in 1993, 1995 and 1997."

xref.title: Diverse Production and Engineering Work
xref.body: With the assistance of Daniel Lanois, Malcolm Burn has produced and engineered for a variety of artists including Iggy Pop, Patti Smith, Bob Dylan, Blue Road View, Midnight Oil, Junkhouse, and John Mellencamp. "With Dan's help Malcolm has had gigs producing an engineering for Iggy Pop and Patty Smith and Bob Dylan and Blue Road View and Midnight Oil and junk house and John Mellon Camp in many many more."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Extensive Touring
xref.body: After the release of their debut album in 2001, Staggered Crossing embarked on tours with notable acts such as Nickelback, The Guess Who, Midnight Oil, Spirit of the West, Blue Rodeo, and Big Sugar, among others. "From there they toured with Nickelback, the Guess Who, Midnight Oil, Spirited the West, Blurodio, Big Sugar and others."
